material.acceptance_criteria: The median gap is attributed with evidence (CI job profile vs local profile over the same artifact); if CI environment overhead explains it, the finding is recorded in AGENTS.md; if a page-side cost remains, a follow-up row names its phase
material.description: After the model-fit deferral, CI medians measured 9842 ms (run 40536986555) and 8720 ms (run 40538066466), while scripts/perf/first-draw.mjs against the locally staged artifact of the same build drew at 3084-3149 ms. Explain the gap: CI swiftshader/CPU contention, artifact layout differences, remaining phase costs (world build dominates: 4.4-4.8 s in CI) vs local. Deciding whether an optimization row is warranted is part of it.

note: Attribution with evidence: rerunning first-draw.mjs on the CI-built artifact (site-green, run 40538066466's build) locally gives medians 3701 ms (3161/3701/6655), so the CI gap is partly measurement variance and partly environment; the phase split shows the kernel -- CI boots the game FASTER (game 162-279 ms vs local 613-1160) while its preview/first-raster phase, which dominates the median, runs 8.5-9.2 s vs local 3.1-6.1 s. No page-side regression left behind; AGENTS.md now treats CI and local first-draw scales as separate (close commit 832c7aefd873167d0bb5ae880fb6f4fb2dd26c8e).
